body.p: Start from scratch in C. Study Xee (Rust, MIT, https://github.com/Paligo/xee) closely: it implements most of XPath 3.1 with one IR and bytecode interpreter shared by XPath and XSLT, the same architecture as this plan. Confirmed at the Phase 0 gate: the substrate keeps the IR out of the value model (function bodies are an interface, ), and parsing uses tree-sitter () rather than a hand-written parser.
